প্রয়োজনীয় প্রশিক্ষণ গ্রহণে আগ্রহী হতে হবে।

Track graduate employment outcomes, with particular emphasis on overseas job placement. Ensure the effective utilization, safety, maintenance, and availability of training facilities, caregiving and other simulation laboratories, machinery, equipment, tools, learning materials, and consumables. Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS), workplace hygiene, and relevant safety standards across classrooms, laboratories, workshops, and practical training environments.
